text.p: OccuSystems Inc said Monday it had signed definitive agreements to acquire 13 occupational healthcare centers, adding a projected $21 million in revenues annually.
The company said the all-stock deals would increase earnings "going forward."
OccuSystems has agreed to acquire Prizm Environmental and Occupational Health Inc in Newark, N.J., which has seven centers, in exchange for 625,000 OccuSystems shares.
It also has agreed to acquire Ideal Occupational Medical Centers Inc in Detroit, which has four centers in the area. in exchange for 500,000 shares.
Also, the company has acquired Occupational Medicine Services Inc of Tulsa, Okla., which operates one occupational healthcare center, in exchange for about 135,000 shares.
